ticket.summary: Repeat customer: kitchen sink draining slow with gurgle, third recurrence this year (snaked Jan and May) - kitchen branch only, no other fixtures affected; camera inspection + snaking booked.

quote_lines.description: Diagnostic visit / camera inspection of kitchen branch line (recurring clog)

ticket.customer_message: Kitchen-only backup with gurgling points to a partial blockage in the kitchen branch line, likely grease re-forming. Since it's the third time, we'll bring a camera to check for a belly or bad fitting rather than just snaking again. Camera inspection $89 + kitchen drain snaking $179 = $268, about 2 hours, tomorrow Tue Sept 1 at 3:00 PM. No after-hours fee since it's still draining. Any repair found by the camera will be quoted on-site before work. Reply if 3 PM doesn't work.
